brief:
A hardline Israeli rabbi issued a controversial ruling regarding stolen Palestinian olives, according to Al Jazeera English, prompting swift condemnation from Palestinians. The decision sparked significant uproar across Palestinian communities and civil society groups.

Details of the specific ruling and the rabbi's reasoning were not immediately available. Palestinian officials and activists have called the decision inflammatory and indicative of broader tensions over land and agricultural resources in the occupied territories.
dek: A controversial ruling by a hardline Israeli rabbi has been condemned by Palestinians.
title: Israeli rabbi's ruling on stolen Palestinian olives draws condemnation
